use default
use Raster.IMAGE
use System.Math

let size = 200
let angles = 360

pentagon() -> IMAGE is
    let image = IMAGE(size, size)

    image.clear(255ub, 255ub, 255ub)
    image.colour(0ub, 0ub, 0ub)
    image.stroke(2.0D)
    image.line(
        (0::5)
            |> map(i =>
                let a = Math.pi * (0.5D + 0.4D * cast double(i)) in
                let x = 100.0D + 70.0D * Math.cos(a) in
                (x = x, y = 105.0D - 70.0D * Math.sin(a)))
            |> collect_list())

    image
si

pentagon().write("pentagon.png")

let source = IMAGE.read("pentagon.png")
let diagonal = Math.sqrt(2.0D) * cast double(size) / 2.0D
let distances = cast int(2.0D * diagonal) + 1

let votes = repeat(0, angles * distances) |> collect_list()

for y in 0..size do
    for x in 0..size do
        if source.pixel(x, y).red < 128ub then
            let dx = cast double(x - size / 2)
            let dy = cast double(size / 2 - y)

            for t in 0..angles do
                let theta = Math.pi * cast double(t) / cast double(angles)
                let rho = dx * Math.cos(theta) + dy * Math.sin(theta)
                let r = cast int(Math.round(rho + diagonal))

                votes[r * angles + t] = votes[r * angles + t] + 1
            od
        fi
    od
od

let most = votes |> reduce(0, int.max)

let peaks = LIST[(theta: int, rho: int, votes: int)]()
let remaining = LIST[int](votes)

for _ in 0..5 do
    let best =
        (0..remaining.count) |> reduce(0, (b, i) =>
            if remaining[i] > remaining[b] then i else b fi)

    let r = best / angles, t = best % angles

    peaks.add((t / 2, r - cast int(Math.round(diagonal)), remaining[best]))

    for dr in -12::12 do
        for dt in -12::12 do
            let rr = r + dr, tt = (t + dt + angles) % angles

            if rr >= 0 /\ rr < distances then
                remaining[rr * angles + tt] = 0
            fi
        od
    od
od

write_line("the five strongest lines, as angle in degrees")
write_line("and distance from the centre:")

for p in peaks |> sort((a, b) => a.theta - b.theta) do
    write_line("  theta {p.theta,3}, rho {p.rho,4} ({p.votes} votes)")
od

let space = IMAGE(angles, distances)

for r in 0..distances do
    for t in 0..angles do
        let level = cast double(votes[r * angles + t]) / cast double(most)
        let shade = cast ubyte(255.0D * Math.sqrt(level))

        space.set_pixel(t, distances - 1 - r, shade, shade, shade)
    od
od

source.show("pentagon.png")

space.write("hough.png")
space.show("hough.png")
